officialSection: 1. 句子基本結構與主詞 (Basic Sentence Structure & Subject-Verb Agreement)
topicZh: be 動詞現在式與代名詞主格/受格/所有格
exemplarStructures: I am / You are / He is

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Present Simple)
topicZh: 現在簡單式（第三人稱單數動詞加 s/es、一般動詞問答、do/does）
topicEn: Present Simple Tense (Third-Person Singular, Do/Does Questions)

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Present Continuous)
topicZh: 現在進行式（be + V-ing、此時此刻正在進行的動作）

officialSection: 1. 句子基本結構 (Sentence Types: Imperatives)
topicZh: 祈使句與指示指令（原形動詞開頭、Please、Don't）

officialSection: 1. 句子基本結構 (Existential Sentences)
topicZh: There is / There are 存在句與數量修飾
exemplarStructures: There is a park near my house.
Are there any students in the room?

officialSection: 3. 介系詞與修飾語 (Prepositions of Time and Place)
topicZh: 時間與地點介系詞 (at / on / in / under / next to / between)

officialSection: 1. 疑問句 (Wh- Information Questions)
topicZh: Wh- 疑問句 (What / Who / Where / When / Why / How)

officialSection: 4. 助動詞 (Modal Auxiliaries: Can / May)
topicZh: 情態助動詞（can 表示能力/許可、may 表示徵詢/推測）

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Past Simple)
topicZh: 過去簡單式（規則動詞 -ed、不規則動詞三態、did 問答）
topicEn: Past Simple Tense (Regular/Irregular Verbs, Did Questions)

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Past Continuous)
topicZh: 過去進行式（was/were + V-ing，與過去某特定時間或 when 子句連用）
exemplarStructures: I was sleeping when you called.
They were playing basketball at 4 PM.

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Future)
topicZh: 未來式（will + 原形動詞 / be going to + 原形動詞）
exemplarStructures: We are going to visit grandma this weekend.

officialSection: 4. 助動詞 (Modal Auxiliaries: Must / Should / Have to)
topicZh: 義務與建議助動詞（must / should / have to / had better）

officialSection: 5. 連接詞與複合句 (Subordinating Conjunctions: Time & Reason)
topicZh: 時間與原因副詞子句 (before / after / when / while / because / although)
exemplarStructures: Wash your hands before you eat.
Although it was raining, they went hiking.

officialSection: 6. 動名詞與不定詞 (Non-finite Verbs: Gerunds and Infinitives)
topicZh: 動名詞 (V-ing) 與不定詞 (to + V) 當主詞/受詞
topicEn: Gerunds (V-ing) and Infinitives (to + V) as Subjects and Objects

officialSection: 7. 形容詞與副詞比較 (Comparison of Adjectives and Adverbs)
topicZh: 形容詞與副詞之原級、比較級 (-er / more) 與最高級 (-est / most)
topicEn: Comparative and Superlative Degrees of Adjectives and Adverbs
exemplarStructures: He is taller than his brother.
This is the most exciting movie I have ever seen.

officialSection: 8. 感官動詞與使役動詞 (Sensory and Causative Verbs)
topicZh: 感官動詞 (see/hear/watch/feel) 與使役動詞 (make/have/let)
topicEn: Sensory Verbs (see/hear + V/V-ing) and Causative Verbs (make/let/have + V)
exemplarStructures: Mom made me clean my room.
I heard someone singing in the park.

officialSection: 2. 動詞時態 (Verb Tenses: Present Perfect)
topicZh: 現在完成式（have/has + p.p.、經驗/持續/完成、since/for/already/yet）
exemplarStructures: I have lived here for five years.
Has he finished the report yet?

officialSection: 9. 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
topicZh: 被動語態（be + p.p.、主動轉被動、by 動作執行者）
exemplarStructures: The cake was made by my sister.
English is spoken all over the world.

officialSection: 5. 名詞子句 (Noun Clauses)
topicZh: 名詞子句（that 引導之陳述名詞子句、whether/if 引導之是否子句）
exemplarStructures: I know that honesty is important.
I wonder whether she will come.

officialSection: 5. 間接問句 (Indirect Questions)
topicZh: 間接問句（Wh- 疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，語序不倒裝）
exemplarStructures: Do you know where the post office is?

officialSection: 10. 關係子句 (Relative Clauses)
topicZh: 關係子句與關係代名詞 (who / which / that / whose)
topicEn: Relative Clauses with Relative Pronouns (Who / Which / That)
exemplarStructures: The boy who won the race is my cousin.
This is the book that I bought yesterday.

officialSection: 5. 條件句 (Conditional Sentences)
topicZh: 條件子句（If 現在式，主要子句未來式 will / can）
topicEn: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, Will/Can + Base Verb)
exemplarStructures: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
